meta.name: press-release
meta.description: Write an Amazon-style press release that defines customer value before building. Use when aligning stakeholders on a new product, feature, or strategic bet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用亚马逊式新闻稿定义产品价值
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发前对齐团队对产品价值的理解
copy.tagline_en: Define product value with an Amazon-style press release
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to align stakeholders on product value before building

howto.what: Claude 会按照亚马逊“逆向工作”方法，帮你写一份产品发布前的新闻稿。它先问客户是谁、发布日会有什么改变，然后生成标题、问题、解决方案、高管引言等完整结构，聚焦客户价值而非功能列表。
howto.when: 当你需要为新产品或功能对齐利益相关者、测试产品故事是否吸引人时触发。最好在开始开发之前使用。

say.text: 帮我写一份亚马逊风格的新闻稿，关于一个给自由职业者用的自动记账工具。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提供客户和问题信息，然后生成新闻稿。

say.text: 用逆向工作法写一份新闻稿：新功能是“一键报销”，面向销售团队。
say.note: Claude 会基于你提供的信息起草新闻稿。

howto.what_en: Claude follows Amazon's 'Working Backwards' method to write a pre-launch press release. It asks who the customer is and what changes for them, then generates headline, problem, solution, executive quote, and more—focusing on customer value, not features.
howto.when_en: Use when aligning stakeholders on a new product or feature, or testing if a product story resonates. Best used before development starts.

say_en.text: Write an Amazon-style press release for an auto-invoicing tool for freelancers.
say_en.note: Claude will prompt for customer and problem details, then generate the release.

say_en.text: Draft a working-backwards press release for a 'one-click expense report' feature for sales teams.
say_en.note: Claude will draft based on the info you provide.
